steps.text: Place the main game board in the center of the table.
Place the Buzzard Gulch Frontier Board next to the main board.
Place the Gambler Track above the main board.
Place the Legendary Story Board overlay over the core Story Card area.
Place the General Store stand at the top of the board.
Assemble the Trading Post stand.
Assemble the Traveling Trader stand.

sections.title: Prepare Stores
sections.summary: Set up item markets and trader inventory.

steps.text: Auto-Fill Stores with the helper, or skip it and follow the manual store setup below.

visual.instruction: Fill the General Store stand with 12 item cards.

steps.text: Manually Fill Stores
steps.summary: Use these steps only if you are not using Auto-Fill Stores.

substeps.text: Remove store randomizer cards for items not being used.
Set aside the standard setup card as a quick store reference.
Shuffle the remaining store randomizer cards facedown.
Deal 1 randomizer card to each General Store slot.
Deal 1 randomizer card to each Trading Post slot.
Place the first revealed Weapon and first revealed Mount in the General Store.
Place the second revealed Weapon and second revealed Mount in the Trading Post.
If using standard setup, make sure each store has at least 1 Weapon and 1 Mount. Replace items randomly if needed.
Place each item deck in the space matching its randomizer card.

visual.instruction: Fill the General Store stand with 12 item cards.

steps.text: Shuffle together the Legendary Items from the selected expansions and place the blocker card on the bottom.
Place the Legendary Item deck facedown in the top-left Traveling Trader slot.
Reveal 3 Legendary Items to the bottom row of the Traveling Trader stand.
Place all remaining item decks in the 2 empty Traveling Trader spaces. Keep their randomizer cards nearby.

sections.title: Prepare Decks
sections.summary: Shuffle only the decks used in this game.

steps.text: Separate money into $10 and $20 decks.
Prepare the Poker deck. If using expansion Poker Cards, swap them for matching base cards by suit and value.
Shuffle the Joker cards into the Poker deck.
Shuffle and place the core small decks beside the board.
Shuffle the Core Story Cards, place the deck on its designated board space, reveal 1 Core Story Card, and place it on the designated spot.
Shuffle the Legendary Story Cards, place the deck on the Legendary Story Board, then reveal 1 random Legendary Story Card onto the board.
Add the Unique Event cards to the Event deck.
Shuffle the Event deck and place it near the board.
Shuffle the Title cards and randomly reveal 1 Title for this game.
Shuffle the Sheriff cards and reveal the top Sheriff card. Replace it whenever the Sheriff loses a fight.
Shuffle the Bandit cards and place the deck facedown near the Fight deck.
Shuffle all Man in Black cards together to form the deck and place it near the board.
Shuffle the Man in Black cards together, excluding P-01, P-04, P-05, P-08, P-09, P-10, and P-15. Place the deck near the board.
Shuffle the Rumor cards and place the deck near the board.
Shuffle the Animal deck and place it beside the game board.
Shuffle the Fish deck and place it beside the game board.
Shuffle the Theatre deck, place it near the board, and reveal 3 Theatre cards faceup.
Shuffle the Prospecting deck with 2 random events.

sections.title: Prepare Tokens
sections.summary: Separate, shuffle, and place token supplies.

steps.text: Shuffle Cattle tokens facedown and place them at their ranches.
Shuffle Longhorn, Outlaw, High Roller, and Claim Jumper tokens facedown.
Shuffle Legendary tokens facedown or place them in a token bag.
Separate Deeds by type and place a Deed token on each Deed location.
Keep Unique Event tokens in a supply near the board.

sections.title: Prepare Board Effects
sections.summary: Place markers and resolve setup effects.

steps.text: Place the end-game marker on {targetLP} LP.
Place Event markers on the 5th space of the Gambler, Marshal, and Wanted tracks, and on every 5th LP space before the end-game marker.
Resolve 1 Event card per 2 players, rounded up. Ignore Sheriff movement because the Sheriff is not placed yet.
Randomly place 1 faceup Frontier token on each Frontier space. Keep unused Frontier tokens nearby.
Reveal the top Trader Movement card and place the Traveling Trader miniature on any empty space in that region.
Place 2 Gold Nuggets at each mining location. Place 1 Gold Nugget on the LP track spaces indicated by the Prospecting rules for {playerCount} players and a {targetLP}-LP game.

sections.title: Prepare Players
sections.summary: Give each player their starting pieces.

steps.text: Each player takes a player mat, scoring cubes, color ring, and wound token.
Use the player mat side with Legendary Token spaces.
Each player takes their Faro chips.
Each player takes their Story disks.
Place 1 scoring cube for each player left of the 1 space on the LP track.
Place 1 scoring cube for each player on the starting space of the Story track.
Place each player’s remaining scoring cubes and Story disks beside the board.

sections.title: Prepare Characters
sections.summary: Get each player's selected character ready for play.

steps.text: Each player chooses a character from the characters available in the selected expansions.
For each chosen character, take that character’s 4 Goal cards.
Each player gains starting items, money, Poker Cards, wounds, and points listed on their character.
If a character starts with Gambler, Legendary, Marshal, Story, or Wanted Points, place a cube on the matching track.
Resolve any starting item abilities, such as Gazette, Provisions, or similar effects.
Highest Wanted player takes the First Player token. If tied or no one is Wanted, choose another method.
Starting with the first player, each player chooses a miniature and attaches their color ring.
Each player places their miniature at the Starting Location on their character card.
If a Starting Location is a General Store, Trading Post, or Saloon, place the miniature on any adjacent space.
Remove any Event, Claim Jumper, High Roller, Longhorn, Outlaw, or Unique Event token from a space where a player starts.
Attach the brown ring to the Sheriff miniature and place the Sheriff at the Sheriff/Marshal Office in Darkrock.
Apply the numbered Bandit stickers to the bottoms of the grey Bandit rings.
Attach grey rings to 6 Bandit miniatures. Place 1 Bandit at each Bandit Hideout that does not contain a player.

Choose a miniature to represent the Man in Black. Place it at the Rail Station or a location chosen by the first player, and place the scoring cube matching its base ring color to the left of the LP track with the player scoring cubes.
After all player miniatures are placed, the player last in turn order places the 3 Hunt Action markers on 3 different unoccupied spaces.
Give each player a player aid.
Confirm all selected modules have been set up.
Confirm the end-game marker is on {targetLP} LP.
Press Start Game when everyone is ready.
